description: A sprite sheet of TWELVE separate underwater aquarium decorations arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell, seen from the side as in a fish tank. Row 1: a pink branching coral, an orange sea fan coral, a purple brain coral, blue tube corals. Row 2: a swaying sea anemone, a scallop shell, a spiral conch shell, an orange starfish. Row 3: an open clam with a shining pearl, a sunken clay amphora, a glowing blue Haven crystal cluster, a tiny sunken wooden shipwreck. Side view, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no fish, no animals, no characters, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
